n, m, limit = map(int, input().split())
import math

g = math.gcd(n, m)
n //= g
m //= g

ratio = 1.0
tol = 1e-10

x_curr = 0
y_curr = 1
x_best = 0
y_best = 1

for y_curr in range(1, limit + 1):
    while abs(ratio * n / m - ratio * x_curr / y_curr) > abs(ratio * n / m - ratio * (x_curr + 10000) / y_curr):
        x_curr += 10000
    while abs(ratio * n / m - ratio * x_curr / y_curr) + tol > abs(ratio * n / m - ratio * (x_curr + 1) / y_curr):
        x_curr += 1
    if abs(ratio * n / m - ratio * x_curr / y_curr) < abs(ratio * n / m - ratio * x_best / y_best):
        x_best = x_curr
        y_best = y_curr

x_adjusted = max(0, x_best - (2 == 2 and x_best != n))
print(f"{x_adjusted}/{y_best}")
